scopeReview: CED FUN-3.C.1 chain rule for compositions, including identification of inner/outer inputs. Uses previous basic derivatives. Trigonometry in radians and logarithm/root domains checked. No implicit or inverse derivative rules required.
varietyReview: General hypotheses and evaluation, polynomial composite, fundamental trig limit, logarithm, exponential sign, actual two-row table composition, Leibniz rates, root/exponential composition, reversed composition order, error diagnosis and zero-inner-rate reasoning.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.

optionReview: The outer derivative must be evaluated at g(a), not generally at a.
Differentiate the outer function at the inner output and multiply by the inner derivative.
